evidence_levels.declared_boundary: A native name has an explicit semantic node/group; incomplete and unverified groups are included only at this level.
evidence_levels.complete_boundary: Coverage is complete_subgraph/complete_semantic_subgraph or an existing semantic primitive; not a proof of native dispatch or matching tensors.
evidence_levels.comparable_contract: At least one complete, event-matchable target has a contract; active/partial scope still applies.
evidence_levels.retained_fixture_match: An original retained descriptor example equals a declared native target contract; sampled branches do not establish full-capture prevalence.
evidence_levels.full_capture_replay: Only report artifacts with the current graph_id and verified mapping artifact hash are included; each declaration remains separate, particularly Kimi phases over one source.
evidence_levels.exact_occurrence_binding: Requires explicit/module/Host evidence independently of source semantics, shapes, timing or repeated layer counts.

refresh_execution.scope: Same interpreter, one independent fresh graph worker per declaration.
